remarks: Beautiful all brick ranch home located in a quiet neighborhood just minutes away from the Birdsong Park Nature Trails, Chestnut Ridge Park and The Village of Orchard Park. The living area has an open concept, anchored by a brick gas fireplace (NRTC). The Living Room has sliding glass doors opening to the backyard oasis. There is a formal dining Room overlooking the front yard. The 3 bedrooms are separately located from the living areas. One bedroom has french doors and new Andersen sliding door to the back yard. There is an updated full bath off the hall with new tile and tub. The spacious primary bedroom has an ensuite bath with a stall shower with a new glass door. The kitchen is very large with hardwood floors, a moveable island, an eating area great for gathering. The wood cabinets are painted a pretty slate blue, and the kitchen has stainless steel appliances including a 5 burner stove with range hood. There are also new sliding glass doors leading to the backyard, making the location convenient when entertaining. The mudroom has a powder room and a separate laundry room. Square footage does not include the family Room/Office, which is an additional 400 sq feet. This room has a separate entrance, which could be great for a home office, art studio or media room. There is a 2 car attached garage and also a 1 car attached garage off the family room. Both with openers. The fully fenced backyard is private with a large patio, an inground pool and a view of the rest of the property which includes fruit trees, a large yard and a shed for additional storage. Some of the upgrades include exterior paint job '26, new remote control garage door on the 2 car garage '26, a new tear off roof '25, new Andersen sliding glass doors from the Living Room to the backyard '22, freshly painted interior '26, new fence '26, new pool heater '24, new pool pump '22. Showings begin immediately. Open house Saturday October 3, 2026, 1PM-3PM.
